episodes.title: By Dawn's Early Light
episodes.summary: Brandon's attempt to live up to his father's high expectations suffers a blow. Sheldon's carefree life as the boss's son comes crashing down in 1929.

episodes.title: Paper and Stone
episodes.summary: Brandon and Chloe clash with their dad after the Blackstar incident. Sheldon confronts a reporter over an exposé on the family business.

episodes.title: Painting the Clouds with Sunshine
episodes.summary: Worried about Sheldon's uncharacteristic behavior, George pays him a visit. A foiled theft lands Hutch on the wrong side of a superpowered crime boss.

episodes.title: All the Devils Are Here
episodes.summary: With her partying spiraling out of control, Chloe nears rock bottom. Sheldon encounters hardship in his search for answers to the visions haunting him.

episodes.title: What's the Use?
episodes.summary: Sheldon tries to assemble a dream team for his quest into the unknown. An autopsy unearths a puzzling object that connects to Chloe's new acquaintance.

episodes.title: Cover Her Face
episodes.summary: Grace sees first-hand how the Code is affecting the younger superheroes. Tempers flare aboard the ship as Sheldon forges ahead with his expedition.

episodes.title: Omnes Pro Uno
episodes.summary: The perilous final leg of their journey pushes Sheldon's ragtag team to the brink. Walter reaches out to a questionable source to extract information.

episodes.title: How It All Ends
episodes.summary: As Walter's situation grows dire, Sheldon and Brandon join forces in a do-or-die showdown with a supervillain. Hutch runs into trouble during a heist.
